message.content: {"caption":"Schematic of bounded, validation-gated skill optimization on an error landscape, with a text-space optimization analogy.","description":"A perspective diagram shows a contoured optimization landscape. The vertical axis is labeled “Val. Error”; the lower-left-to-center axis is “Skill Space,” and an arrow from the central base toward the right is labeled “better task-specific skill.” The surface is peach-colored at the upper left and slopes into a blue basin toward the lower right; contour curves mark regions of the landscape. A document labeled S₀ starts on the upper-left part of the surface. Blue directional arrows and an orange path descend through a sequence of small document-like selection-gate symbols toward a document in the blue basin. Green check marks appear on the successive gate symbols, indicating accepted edits. The path is labeled “bounded skill edits,” and nearby text reads “stable, controlled optimization.” Red dashed arrows branch away from the path, labeled “rejected side updates”; the nearby label identifies a “held-out selection gate.” In contrast, long gray dashed curved arrows make larger jumps across the surface. They are labeled “ad hoc updates” and “large semantic jumps, unstable updates,” and lead toward a separate document on the slope labeled “suboptimal skill.” The document at the lower-right basin is labeled “better task-specific skill.” A connector from it branches to three rounded labels: “better task-specific ability,” “cross-model /harness generalization,” and “low-cost transfer and iteration.” At upper right, a small flow diagram shows x pointing to a document labeled “Skill S,” with an orange flame symbol beside it; the document feeds a neural-network icon labeled f, whose connected nodes have arrows directed through the network toward output y. A blue snowflake above the network denotes the frozen model in this schematic. Below is a box titled “Text-space optimization analogy,” listing mappings: parameter → skill document; gradient direction → trajectory-derived edit direction; learning rate → edit budget; validation check → held-out selection gate; stable training setting → batch / minibatch / schedule / gate.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
